entities.name: Koll
entities.description: A talented dwarf smith from Kaldheim who forged the Sword of the Realms.

entities.name: Sword of the Realms
entities.description: Blade of Tyrite sharp enough to cut a path between realms.

entities.name: Halvar
entities.description: God who defeated Sarulf and saved Koll.

entities.name: Tyrite
entities.description: Godly material that transformed Koll's hand.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: Planeswalker who disguised himself as Valki and killed Koll for the Sword.

events.summary: Sarulf attacks Koll, but Halvar defeats the monster.
events.quote: the god Halvar intervened and defeated the monster

events.summary: Koll touches a chunk of Tyrite, turning his hand to Tyrite, and swears to forge a blade for Halvar.
events.quote: transforming his hand into Tyrite itself

events.summary: Koll forges the Sword of the Realms.
events.quote: a blade he called the Sword of the Realms

events.summary: Tibalt, disguised as Valki, tries to get the Sword; Koll refuses and Tibalt kills him and takes it.
events.quote: Tibalt killed the dwarf and took the Sword for himself

relations.quote: the forger of the Sword of the Realms

relations.note: Killed him to take the Sword.
relations.quote: Tibalt killed the dwarf and took the Sword for himself
the god Halvar intervened and defeated the monster
